notes: Fastned graph for the GV60 77.4 kWh / 800 V E-GMP pack, 2-95 % SoC, 300 kW class, battery near 30 C. About 215-233 kW from 2 % to 52 % (peak 234.8 kW at 52 %, 0.8 % over the 233 kW rating), then steps down to about 176 kW at 55 %, 128 kW at 80 % and 32 kW at 95 %. Same hardware as the IONIQ 5/EV6 77.4 kWh E-GMP pack; the plateau-then-drop shape agrees with the OoS EV6 prototype and electrive IONIQ 5 curves already recorded for E-GMP (plateau to about 50-55 %, steep fall after). European-spec car; Fastned dates it 2022-2025, so the 2025 cars are assumed to match. One series shown on both the Fastned GV60 and GV70 pages, so not two independent measurements. The US/Canada MY2025 pack (77.4 vs 84 kWh) is unconfirmed, so the match to the Fastned 77.4 kWh (2022-2025) graph is unproven.
